name: Password hashing
summary: Do not create an AMSL password hashing primitive.
proposed_guarantees: Delegate cryptographic primitives to maintained libraries

evidence.basis: Candidate boundary informed by maintainer source inspection; identifying evidence is not published. No AMSL consumer adoption is claimed.

alternatives.name: Go x/crypto
alternatives.assessment: Use a maintained password hashing implementation with reviewed parameters.

open_questions: Reconsider only for a demonstrated integration gap, not new crypto.
